{{Short description|Danish mathematician (1947–2014)}}
'''Hans-Bjørn Foxby''' (1947 – 2014) was a [[Denmark|Danish]] [[mathematician]], and a professor of mathematics at [[University of Copenhagen]]. [[Foxby class]]es are named after him.<ref>{{cite journal |author=Sather-Wagstaff |first=Keri Ann|author-link=Keri Sather-Wagstaff |title=Complete intersection dimensions and Foxby classes |url=https://www.ndsu.edu/pubweb/~ssatherw/DOCS/ssw-cidfc.pdf |format=PDF |journal=Journal of Pure and Applied Algebra |accessdate=2016-01-27}}</ref>

Foxby's research was in [[commutative algebra]]. He died from [[Alzheimer's disease]] on 8 April 2014.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.math.ku.dk/english/about/news/foxby/ |title=Obituary: Hans-Bjørn Foxby – University of Copenhagen |publisher=Math.ku.dk |date= |accessdate=2016-01-27}}</ref>
